stories.headline: Sysco to Acquire Jetro Restaurant Depot for $29.1B in Cash and Stock

key_facts.fact: Sysco will pay $21.6 billion in cash and 91.5 million Sysco shares for Jetro Restaurant Depot, totaling $29.1 billion including debt.
key_facts.excerpt: Sysco said that it has a deal to acquire Jetro Restaurant Depot for $29.1 billion in cash and stock. Restaurant Depot shareholders will receive $21.6 billion in cash in the deal and 91.5 million shares of Sysco stock.

key_facts.fact: Restaurant Depot operates 166 warehouse stores in 35 states generating $16 billion in annual revenue and $2.1 billion in EBITDA, implying a 14.6x operating income multiple.
key_facts.excerpt: It operates 166 large-format warehouse stores in 35 states that generate $16 billion in annual revenue, including $2.1 billion in EBITDA. The total value of the deal represents a multiple of 14.6 times Restaurant Depot's operating income.

key_facts.fact: Sysco plans to fund the deal with $21 billion in new and hybrid debt plus $1 billion in cash on hand; Restaurant Depot shareholders will own 16% of Sysco upon closing.
key_facts.excerpt: Sysco would fund the deal through $21 billion of new and hybrid debt, along with $1 billion of cash and equity on hand.

key_facts.fact: The combined company generated nearly $100 billion in revenue and $6.4 billion in adjusted EBITDA, with $250 million in projected annual cost synergies within three years.
key_facts.excerpt: The combined company last year generated nearly $100 billion in revenue and $6.4 billion in adjusted EBITDA. The combined companies are projecting $250 million in annual cost synergies within the first three years.

key_facts.fact: Sysco expects the deal to be accretive to EPS in the mid- to high-single digits in the first year, with closing expected by Q3 FY2027.
key_facts.excerpt: Sysco expects the deal to add to earnings per share in the mid- to high-single-digits in the first year following its close, which is expected by the third quarter of Sysco's fiscal 2027.

key_facts.fact: Sysco shares fell nearly 5% in premarket trading after the announcement; the company also paused its share repurchase program.
key_facts.excerpt: Shares of Sysco, which has a market capitalization of $39.2 billion, were down nearly 5% in premarket trading. Sysco also said it was pausing its share repurchase program.

sources.title: Sysco to acquire Restaurant Depot for $29.1B
Top US food supplier Sysco strikes $29 billion deal for Jetro Restaurant Depot

stories.headline: Eli Lilly Signs $2.75B Licensing Deal with AI Drug Developer Insilico Medicine

key_facts.fact: Insilico Medicine agreed a global licensing and research deal with Eli Lilly worth up to $2.75 billion including milestone payments, with $115 million paid upfront.
key_facts.excerpt: Insilico Medicine said on Sunday it has agreed a global licensing and research deal with U.S. drugmaker Eli Lilly, that could be worth up to $2.75 billion, including milestone payments.

key_facts.fact: Lilly receives exclusive license to develop, manufacture, and commercialize Insilico's preclinical oral drug candidates, including a GLP-1 candidate for diabetes.
key_facts.excerpt: Under the agreement, Lilly will receive an exclusive licence to develop, manufacture and commercialize preclinical oral drug candidates by Insilico Medicine for selected disease areas.

key_facts.fact: Insilico is eligible for development, regulatory, and commercial milestone payments plus tiered royalties on future sales.
key_facts.excerpt: Insilico Medicine also said that it will receive an upfront payment of $115 million and is eligible for development, regulatory and commercial milestone payments that could take the total deal value to about $2.75 billion, as well as tiered royalties on future sales.

key_facts.fact: The deal reflects pharma's increasing turn to AI to accelerate R&D, aligned with the FDA's push to reduce animal testing.
key_facts.excerpt: Pharmaceutical companies are increasingly turning to AI to accelerate R&D, betting on new modelling tools and automated labs to unlock efficiency gains across their pipeline.

key_facts.fact: Insilico Medicine is listed on the Hong Kong stock exchange; its CEO Alex Zhavoronkov described Lilly as 'better in AI than Insilico.'
key_facts.excerpt: Alex Zhavoronkov, CEO of Insilico Medicine, can't stop complimenting Eli Lilly. 'Lilly is better in AI than Insilico, and no other company is better in AI than us … except for these guys,' he said.

sources.title: Insilico Medicine secures $2.75 billion drug collaboration with Eli Lilly
Lilly will commercialize Insilico's AI-discovered oral drug candidates

stories.headline: DOJ Issues Subpoenas in Paramount-Warner Bros. Discovery $110B Merger Probe

key_facts.fact: The DOJ has begun issuing subpoenas as part of its investigation into the proposed $110 billion acquisition involving Paramount Skydance and Warner Bros. Discovery.
key_facts.excerpt: The U.S. Department of Justice has begun issuing subpoenas as part of its ongoing investigation into the proposed $110 billion acquisition involving Paramount Skydance and Warner Bros. Discovery.

key_facts.fact: Investigators are examining how the combined company would influence studio output, content rights ownership, streaming competition, and downstream effects on movie theaters.
key_facts.excerpt: Regulators are now focusing on how the merger could reshape competition, content distribution, and the broader media landscape... investigators are also examining potential downstream effects on movie theaters.

key_facts.fact: Acting AAG Omeed Assefi said Paramount will 'absolutely not' be fast-tracked for approval; the European Commission and Canadian authorities have also begun engaging third parties.
key_facts.excerpt: Acting Assistant Attorney General Omeed Assefi recently emphasized that the deal would not receive expedited treatment, stating that Paramount will 'absolutely not' be fast-tracked for approval due to political considerations.

key_facts.fact: Paramount has committed to paying WBD shareholders a quarterly 'ticking fee' of 25 cents per share starting October if the deal remains incomplete.
key_facts.excerpt: The company has committed to paying Warner Bros. shareholders a quarterly 'ticking fee' of 25 cents per share starting in October if the deal remains incomplete.

key_facts.fact: Paramount projects approximately $6 billion in cost synergies from the merger, mostly from streamlining technology, real estate, and corporate functions.
key_facts.excerpt: Paramount has projected approximately $6 billion in cost synergies from the merger... the company expects most of these savings to come from streamlining technology infrastructure, real estate, and other corporate functions.

sources.title: DOJ Issues Subpoenas in Paramount-Warner Bros. Discovery Merger Probe

stories.headline: Federal Judge Halts Nexstar-Tegna $6.2B Merger Integration on Antitrust Grounds

key_facts.fact: US District Judge Troy L. Nunley in Sacramento granted DirecTV's request to pause Nexstar-Tegna post-merger integration, even though the deal had already been finalized days earlier.
key_facts.excerpt: US District Judge Troy L. Nunley in Sacramento granted DirecTV's request to pause the companies' post-merger integration efforts, even though the deal had already been finalized days earlier.

key_facts.fact: DirecTV and eight state attorneys general led by California argue the combined entity would control 265 TV stations reaching approximately 80% of US households.
key_facts.excerpt: The states argued that the combined entity would control 265 full-power television stations, reaching approximately 80% of US households.

key_facts.fact: The judge noted the companies 'do not contest this merger will increase Nexstar's bargaining leverage to extract higher fees' on retransmission rates.
key_facts.excerpt: The judge noted in his 24-page order that the companies 'do not contest this merger will increase Nexstar's bargaining leverage to extract higher fees.'

key_facts.fact: A hearing is scheduled for April 7 to determine whether the pause should remain in place pending a full trial.
key_facts.excerpt: Nunley has scheduled a hearing for April 7 to determine whether the pause should remain in place pending a full trial.

key_facts.fact: Although the DOJ and FCC approved the transaction, the legal battle underscores concerns about media industry consolidation.
key_facts.excerpt: Although the US Department of Justice and the Federal Communications Commission approved the transaction, the legal battle underscores ongoing concerns about consolidation in the media industry.

sources.title: Judge Orders Pause on Nexstar-Tegna Integration Amid Antitrust Challenge
Local News, National Showdown: Eight State AGs Move To Block The Nexstar-Tegna Deal

stories.headline: Elliott Wins Board Overhaul at Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings

key_facts.fact: Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings entered a cooperation agreement with Elliott Investment Management, resulting in a full reconstitution of the board of directors.
key_facts.excerpt: The parent company of Norwegian Cruise Line has entered into a cooperation agreement with Elliott Investment Management. The agreement will result in the reconstitution of the company's board of directors.

key_facts.fact: Four long-standing board members will resign effective March 31, replaced by five new independent directors selected jointly by the company and Elliott.
key_facts.excerpt: Under the terms, four long-standing board members will resign effective March 31. They will be replaced by five new independent directors selected through mutual agreement between the company and Elliott.

key_facts.fact: The new CEO will also assume the role of chairman; the board will increase to nine directors, eight of whom qualify as independent.
key_facts.excerpt: The recently appointed President and Chief Executive Officer will also assume the role of chairman... The board's size will immediately increase to nine directors, eight of whom will qualify as independent.

key_facts.fact: New directors include former executives from British Airways and Disney Experiences, plus CEOs of a technology company and an investment firm.
key_facts.excerpt: Five new individuals will join the board, including former executives from British Airways and Disney Experiences, as well as the chief executives of a technology company and an investment firm, and a managing partner from a private equity group.

key_facts.fact: Elliott had previously criticized the company for 'excellent ships but poor strategy execution and high costs' and expressed confidence the new board would restore investor confidence.
key_facts.excerpt: It had previously cited excellent ships but poor strategy execution and high costs. Elliott expressed confidence that the new board would help restore investor confidence and return the company to best-in-class financial performance.

sources.title: Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings Reaches Board Agreement with Elliott Investment Management

stories.headline: Indorama Ventures Merges with Blackstone-Backed EPL in $2B India Packaging Deal

key_facts.fact: Indorama Ventures will merge with Blackstone-backed EPL Limited to create a $2 billion packaging entity, with EPL valued at approximately $1.2 billion — a 70% premium over its closing stock price.
key_facts.excerpt: The combined entity is valued at $2 billion, with EPL valued at approximately $1.2 billion. This represents a substantial 70% premium over EPL's closing stock price before the deal was announced.

key_facts.fact: Upon completion, Indorama Ventures will hold 51.8% of the merged company, following its earlier 24.9% investment in EPL in February 2025.
key_facts.excerpt: Upon completion, Indorama Ventures is set to hold a 51.8% stake in the merged company, following its earlier 24.9% investment in EPL in February 2025.

key_facts.fact: The merger is part of IVL's 'IVL 2.0' strategy emphasizing value creation and market consolidation in India's packaging market, projected to reach $92 billion by FY30.
key_facts.excerpt: This merger is a key part of IVL's IVL 2.0 strategy, which emphasizes value creation and market consolidation over rapid expansion... India's packaging industry is projected for significant growth, with forecasts estimating it will reach $92 billion by FY30.

key_facts.fact: The deal is expected to close within 12 months pending regulatory approvals.
key_facts.excerpt: The merger is expected to close within 12 months, pending approvals.

sources.title: Indorama Ventures Buys EPL in India for $2B, Paying 70% Premium

stories.headline: Blackstone-Led Consortium Acquires Royal Challengers Bengaluru for $1.78B

key_facts.fact: A consortium of Aditya Birla Group, Times of India Group, Bolt Ventures, and Blackstone agreed to acquire 100% of Royal Challengers Bengaluru from United Spirits (Diageo subsidiary) for INR 166.6 billion (~$1.78 billion).
key_facts.excerpt: A consortium comprising Aditya Birla Group, The Times of India Group, Bolt Ventures, and Blackstone has agreed to acquire 100% of Royal Challengers Bengaluru from United Spirits Limited in a transaction valuing the franchise at INR 166.6 billion, approximately $1.78 billion.

key_facts.fact: The deal includes both the men's IPL team and the women's WPL team; RCB won its first IPL title in 2025.
key_facts.excerpt: The deal includes both the men's team competing in the Indian Premier League and the women's team in the Women's Premier League... Royal Challengers Bengaluru is one of the most prominent franchises in global cricket, having won its first IPL title in 2025.

key_facts.fact: Aryaman Vikram Birla will serve as Chairman and Satyan Gajwani as Vice Chairman of the franchise under the new ownership.
key_facts.excerpt: Under the new ownership structure, Aryaman Vikram Birla will serve as Chairman of the franchise, while Satyan Gajwani will serve as Vice Chairman.

key_facts.fact: The transaction marks a strategic shift for United Spirits as it focuses on its core beverage alcohol business under Diageo.
key_facts.excerpt: The transaction marks a strategic shift for United Spirits, a subsidiary of Diageo, as it sharpens its focus on its core beverage alcohol business.

sources.title: Royal Challengers Bengaluru: $1.78 Billion Acquisition By Consortium Including Blackstone

stories.headline: RTL Offers EU Remedies to Fast-Track Approval for Sky Deutschland Takeover

key_facts.fact: RTL is preparing to submit concessions to the European Commission to address competition concerns related to its planned acquisition of Sky Deutschland, with possible remedies including outsourcing advertising sales to third parties.
key_facts.excerpt: RTL is preparing to offer remedies to EU regulators in a move likely to secure early approval for its planned acquisition of Sky Deutschland... Possible remedies could include outsourcing advertising sales to third parties.

key_facts.fact: If RTL submits remedies, the EU review deadline extends by 10 working days beyond April 8, with approval likely at the end of the initial review.
key_facts.excerpt: If RTL submits remedies, the Commission's preliminary review deadline would be extended by 10 working days beyond the current 8 April 2026 deadline, with approval likely at the end of the initial review.

key_facts.fact: The acquisition would combine major sports rights (Bundesliga, Premier League, F1) and strengthen RTL's streaming via Sky's WOW service to compete with Netflix, Disney+ and Amazon.
key_facts.excerpt: The acquisition would combine major sports and entertainment rights, including Bundesliga, Premier League and Formula 1, and strengthen RTL's position in streaming through Sky's WOW service.

key_facts.fact: RTL Group reported 2025 revenue of €6.0 billion with streaming revenue up 26% to €509 million and paying subscribers up 19% to 8.1 million.
key_facts.excerpt: RTL Group reported revenue of €6.0 billion for 2025, with streaming revenue rising 26% to €509 million and paying subscribers increasing 19% to 8.1 million.

key_facts.fact: German media regulator KEK cleared the transaction in September 2025; RTL expects to close in H1 2026.
key_facts.excerpt: In September 2025, German media regulator KEK cleared the transaction... RTL Group indicated that it expects to the deal to be closed in the first half of 2026.

sources.title: RTL offers remedies to fast-track EU approval for Sky Deutschland takeover

stories.headline: Advent International Commits $1B to Defense Tech, Co-Leads Shield AI $1.5B Round

key_facts.fact: Advent International announced a commitment to invest up to $1 billion in next-generation defense technology companies, building on over $15 billion deployed in the defense sector since 2020.
key_facts.excerpt: Advent International announced a commitment to invest up to $1 billion in next-generation defense technology companies... Since 2020, Advent has deployed more than $15 billion across the global defense sector.

key_facts.fact: As its initial investment, Advent signed a definitive agreement to co-lead Shield AI's $1.5 billion Series G round, which values the company at $12.7 billion.
key_facts.excerpt: Advent has signed a definitive agreement to make an initial investment in Shield AI, co-leading the company's $1.5 billion Series G funding round. The round values Shield AI at $12.7 billion.

key_facts.fact: Shield AI, founded in 2015, develops AI-powered autonomous systems for air operations; the transaction is expected to close in Q2 2026.
key_facts.excerpt: Founded in 2015, Shield AI develops AI-powered autonomous systems designed to support air operations... The Shield AI transaction is expected to close in the second quarter of 2026.

key_facts.fact: Advent's prior defense investments include Cobham, Ultra Electronics, Vantor, and Attalon.
key_facts.excerpt: Advent has deployed more than $15 billion across the global defense sector, including investments in companies such as Cobham, Ultra Electronics, Vantor, and Attalon.

sources.title: Advent: $1 Billion Commitment To Next-Generation Defense Technology Investment Strategy
Advent Co-Leads $1.5 Billion Investment In Shield AI

stories.headline: Motorola Solutions to Buy Bell's Land Mobile Radio Business for C$675M

key_facts.fact: Motorola Solutions will acquire Bell Mobility's land mobile radio (LMR) network business for C$675 million, expected to close in Q4 2026 pending regulatory approval.
key_facts.excerpt: Motorola Solutions is picking up the land mobile radio (LMR) network business from Bell Mobility in a deal worth a cool $675 million CAD... expected to wrap up in the final quarter of 2026 once the usual regulatory hurdles are cleared.

key_facts.fact: Bell and Motorola have co-managed secure radio networks serving Canadian emergency services and businesses for over 30 years.
key_facts.excerpt: Bell and Motorola have spent the last 30 years co-managing the secure radio networks that Canadian emergency services and businesses lean on every day.

key_facts.fact: Bell will remain as a key service delivery partner even after transferring the network assets to Motorola.
key_facts.excerpt: Even with Motorola taking over the driver's seat of the network itself, Bell isn't walking away entirely. They will stay on as a key service delivery partner.

sources.title: Motorola to Buy Bell's Radio Business for $675 Million
